limitations: Static <=0, <=1 and <=10 m MSL thresholds are not RCP/year forecasts, flood probabilities, inundation extents or clinical impacts.
Original ACTUALE is modeled as ACTUAL_MHHW_ELEV_M; do not apply a geoid/MDT correction to it blindly.
New DEM versus original differences combine terrain, datum, epoch and resolution, not datum alone.
MSL raster cells <=-7 m are excluded; missing/out-of-coverage cells remain unavailable.
GLL-DTMv2 approximately 1 km cells support portfolio screening, not site design.
RCP colour categories are flags; overlap tables are not validation against ground truth.

Original numeric heights are unverified; the source contains many zeros whose assessed/fill semantics are unresolved. Raw MHHW/MSL numeric overlap is an optional audit, not validated elevation evidence.

sampling.method: containing pixel / nearest grid cell; no interpolation
sampling.overlap: first finite unmasked cell in manifest path order
sampling.nodata: mask/nonfinite -> unavailable; try later overlapping tiles
sampling.scale_offset: raster band scale and offset applied
